name: Gentoo
summary: Gentoo's Council expressly forbids contributing any content created with the assistance of natural-language-processing AI tools to Gentoo or its official projects. It does not prohibit adding packages for AI-related software or for upstream software that was developed with such tools.

evidence.quote: It is expressly forbidden to contribute to Gentoo any content that has been created with the assistance of Natural Language Processing artificial intelligence tools.
This policy affects Gentoo contributions and the official Gentoo projects.
